method: Three read-only research passes over origin/main a4742f6b (student-side; staff and institution; trust, company and operations), one workspace group each, every cited path checked to exist by script; judgement calls are recorded in the notes. Local-first screens whose device store syncs through app/src/lib/cloud.ts into public.state are rated connected ("via store sync" in the note); downgrade in bulk to code-present if local-first persistence should not count. Capability links are curated by hand to the prototype routes that carry the capability; a capability takes the lowest status of its routes.
